commit.message:
fix(ai): retry node-fetch 'request to ... failed' errors

Google Vertex ADC token refresh failures are reported by node-fetch as
'request to <url> failed, reason: ...' and were never auto-retried.

fixes #10996

fix(ai): retry node-fetch 'request to ... failed' errors

Google Vertex ADC token refresh failures are reported by node-fetch as
'request to <url> failed, reason: ...' and were never auto-retried.

fixes #10996

fix(ai): use mimo-v2.6 models in Xiaomi tests

The model catalog replaced mimo-v2.5 and mimo-v2.5-pro with mimo-v2.6-flash
and mimo-v2.6-pro, so tests referencing the old IDs failed type-checking.

fix(coding-agent): use mimo-v2.6-pro as Xiaomi default model

The generated Xiaomi catalogs no longer include mimo-v2.5-pro.

fix(coding-agent): remove fixed output limits from summary requests (#11036)

Compaction summaries were limited to 0.8 * compaction.reserveTokens (13107 by default), turn-prefix summaries to 0.5 * reserveTokens, and branch summaries to a hardcoded 4096. On providers where reasoning shares the output limit (OpenAI Responses, adaptive Anthropic), high thinking levels used most of that limit and compaction failed with "generation hit the token cap", even though the model allows far more output.

Tying the limit to reserveTokens assumed the summary request is as large as the full context, so its output had to fit in the reserved space. It is usually much smaller: recent messages kept by keepRecentTokens are not sent, a split turn goes to a separate request, tool results are truncated, and tool definitions and the normal system prompt are not included. Manual compaction can also run long before the context is full. The provider layer already sizes output from the actual request, using the model's output limit reduced to fit the remaining context, as for normal turns.

Summary requests now set no maxTokens and rely on that. compaction.reserveTokens only controls when compaction starts.

generateSummary() and generateSummaryWithUsage() now ignore the reserveTokens parameter.

closes #9512, closes #9075, closes #10908

commit.message:
fix(ai): treat whitespace-only tool output as empty

Whitespace-only tool results (e.g. a bare \r\n from bash) were sent verbatim
to OpenAI Completions, OpenAI Responses, and Google providers. Some providers
reject that with a 400, which then repeats on every request in the session.
They now use the same placeholder as empty output.

closes #8720
